summary: Silo Pharma, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a 1-for-15 reverse stock split effective June 2, 2026, with trading on a split-adjusted basis beginning June 3, 2026. The split reclassified every 15 shares into 1 share, reduced authorized shares to 6,666,667, and adjusted outstanding options and warrants proportionally; fractional shares were rounded up. No price per share, premium, or board recommendation is stated. This is a routine capital-structure adjustment, not a special situation. It maintains the Nasdaq listing and does not involve a transaction category.
